caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a lion's head door knocker, shown from both a front and a side view. The lion's head is rendered in shades of gold and brown, with wavy, textured fur surrounding the face. The eyes, nose, and mouth are clearly defined, and the lion is biting down on a circular ring, which hangs downward and is also colored gold. The side view, to the right of the front view, displays the profile of the lion's face and the thickness of the ring. The composition is centered on a plain, light tan background, with a thin rectangular border surrounding the images. At the lower left corner, there is a scale in inches, and at the lower right corner, the name "P. Johnson" appears.
title: Drawer Pull
